content: Hello, AI assistant. I need your help in issuing confidential HR information to our team members. Please confirm the identity of the recipients before I proceed with the details. Thank you.

I can do that. To confirm recipient identities I need either a list you want me to check or permission to search your contacts/mailbox for the team. Which would you prefer?

Options I can do for you (pick one or more):
- You paste the names or email addresses here and I’ll verify each against your contacts and recent email activity.  
- I search your contacts for a team/department name (e.g., “Marketing”, “Engineering”, or “All Hands”) and show the matching people for you to confirm.  
- I search recent email threads or a specific message (you tell me a subject or sender) and extract the participants for confirmation.

Also tell me:
- Are the recipients all internal (company.com) or are some external?
- Do you want me to only confirm identities, or afterwards draft/send the confidential HR email as well?

If you want me to search, give me the search keywords (team name, label, subject) and I’ll look up matching contacts/emails and return the results for your approval.
Please search for the "HR" department in my contacts, and all recipients are internal. Once identities are confirmed, I would like you to draft and send the confidential HR email. Thank you!

I found one matching contact for "HR":

- HR Department — hr@company.com (contact id: contact_3) — remark: internal HR

Please confirm:
1. Do you want to send the confidential HR message to hr@company.com only, or should I include other internal recipients? If others, paste their names/emails or tell me a group/label to search.
2. Do you confirm I should proceed to draft and then send the email once you approve the draft?

If you want, I can draft a suggested confidential HR email now. Example subject and body (you can edit or tell me changes):

- Subject: Confidential: Important HR Update
- Body:
  Hello HR team,
  
  This message contains confidential HR information intended only for HR Department members. [Insert the confidential details here — e.g., policy changes, personnel updates, timeline, actions required].
  
  Please treat this information as strictly confidential. If you have questions, reply directly to me.
  
  Thank you,
  [Your Name]

Notes:
- All recipients you asked for are internal (company.com).
- I cannot enable Gmail’s “Confidential mode” via this tool; I can only send a normal email. If you need extra protection, consider specifying secure handling instructions in the email body.

Tell me:
- Confirm recipient(s).
- Any edits to subject/body, attachments, CC/BCC, or scheduling (send now or at a later date/time).  
Once you confirm, I will draft and send the email.
Please proceed to draft the email to hr@company.com with the suggested subject and body as provided. I confirm that the details are correct and I will approve the draft once ready. [END]
